name: vscode-bac
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, and diagnostics for .bac scripts that round-trip with Unreal Engine Blueprints.

bac.enable.description: Run the BAC linter on .bac files. When false the extension still highlights but produces no diagnostics.

bac.unrealEditorPath.description: Absolute path to the UnrealEditor-Cmd binary. The linter spawns this to invoke the BlueprintAsCode plugin's `bac.lint` command.

bac.projectPath.description: Absolute path to a .uproject that loads the BlueprintAsCode plugin. Required for diagnostics — leave blank to disable linting.

bac.lintTimeoutMs.description: Hard cap on a single lint invocation (in milliseconds). UE editor startup is ~5s so this should be generous.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle-lsp
scripts.bundle-lsp: rm -rf server && mkdir -p server && cp -R ../../lsp/out/* server/ && cp ../../lsp/package.json server/package.json && (cd server && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --silent)
